Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) support for Citus 10.2 generally available

Body.Content:
The latest Citus 10.2 version is now available for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) and includes:

  • Support for PostgreSQL 14
  • Simplified partition maintenance via partition management for time series
  • Indexes on partitioned tables with columnar partitions
  • Constraints on columnar tables
  • Improved performance for lookup queries on columnar tables
  • Faster DROPs and more

You can start using Citus 10.2 by creating an Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Hyperscale (Citus) server group with PostgreSQL 13 or PostgreSQL 14.

Learn more.
